Entries.Text: Port

Port a whole Dark Souls III map into an existing map in this project ({0}): every map piece the DS3 map places, with its materials and textures, its collision, and the map's parts at their DS3 positions plus the offset. The source project is only read.
Source Project
The Dark Souls III project the map is read from. Projects are created in the Project Editor.
Maps
The DS3 map to port, and the map of this project it is written into.
{0} (loaded)
{0} is loaded in the Map Editor. It will be unloaded before the port starts.
Options
The offset is added to every ported part's DS3 position. The options choose what is ported.
Ported objects need asset param rows. They are added to the Param Editor's params when the port finishes, as one edit you can undo there, and written to regulation.bin when you save the params.
Porting objects needs the Param Editor's {0} param, which isn't loaded. Enable the Param Editor for this project and wait for its params to load, or turn off Port objects.
